title: Aer Capstone Design II
description: The second semester of the capstone design sequence in aerospace engineering. Students will complete a project concerned with the design of a complex system of current interest to aerospace engineers. Students will work in small groups and emphasis will be on original work. Topics include engineering ethics, design and communication. Lecture, one hour; laboratory, four hours per week. Taken in semester immediately following AER 411.
prerequisites: AER 411, Engineering Standing, taken in semester immediately following AER 411
